podcast.body: Released in the spring of 1991, this song became School of Fish's only alt-rock radio hit. It featured a grinding guitar style that anticipated the sound later popularized by groups like The Smashing Pumpkins, making it "ahead of its time" as it was released before grunge truly entered the popular vocabulary. "This is their one hit wonder from the spring of 1991. It's called Pre-Strange Days."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2

podcast.body: This song represents School of Fish's sole significant hit during their existence, earning it the number 49 spot on a list of alt-rock one-hit wonders. It garnered 10.6 million combined plays and views as of February 2026, with a calculated one-hit wonder score of 1.27 out of 10. "School of Fish and Three Strange Days on our list of the 50 biggest alt rock one hit wonders of all time."
